title: Ekta Malviya v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. & Ors.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J.; Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; respondent no. 3 to decide the billing claim under Clause 6.5 within six weeks.
headnote: Where a consumer's objection to a bill is already pending before the concerned authority, the High Court will not examine the bill on merits. It disposes of the writ by directing that authority to decide the claim in accordance with Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within six weeks of a certified copy.
facts: Ekta Malviya filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and others, challenging a bill raised against her. At the hearing, her claim in respect of that bill was already pending before the concerned authority (respondent no. 3). She sought judicial intervention on the bill rather than awaiting that authority's decision.

holding_units.holding: Where a consumer's claim against a bill is already pending before the concerned authority, the writ court will not decide the bill on merits and will dispose of the petition by directing that authority to determine the claim in accordance with Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within a stipulated period.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the bill raised against the petitioner
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 3 to decide under Clause 6.5.
